'''''Portrait of a Twi'lek Female''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted a [[Color/Legends|teal]] [[Gender/Legends|Female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] with purple [[Eye/Legends|eyeshadow]], and came in eight frames: A large plain gold frame; a large ornate gold frame; a large plain silver frame; a large ornate silver frame; a medium plain gold frame; a medium plain silver frame; a small ornate gold frame; and a small ornate silver frame.

==Behind the scenes==
The portrait of a Twi'lek female was planned to be used for the Jabba's Theme Park area in ''Star Wars Galaxy.''
